v1.0 of Analytics Engine Guidance materials is now live: https://analytics.cal-adapt.org/guidance/
The new suite of guidance materials includes:
- An overview of climate models and projections,
- How to use Analytics Engine outputs for decision-making,
- A glossary of frequently used terms, and
- Key references

An important feature of the new materials is the "[Guidance on Using Climate Data in Decision-Making](https://analytics.cal-adapt.org/guidance/using_in_decision_making/)" section. This section provides original content and practical answers to common questions regarding the use of climate data, such as selecting appropriate data and models, and considering spatial and temporal scales.
